name: Nature support area (Plads til naturen and Naturens kvalitet)
summary: Danish foundation funding land-based nature projects: rewilding, nature restoration, ecological connections between sites and applied knowledge for managing habitats. Any organisation, company or person with a Danish CVR or CPR number can apply at any time.

eligibility.rule: Have a Danish CVR number or CPR number
Apply for a project that has not started or ended
Submit a new project when applying again after previous support
No overhead, though reasonable running and admin support is allowed
Do not request study stays, study trips or congress participation
Do not apply on grounds of poor health or poor finances

administered_by.quote: Fonden bidrager til at gøre naturen til en folkesag.

applicant_types.quote: Alle organisationer, foreninger, virksomheder og lignende, som har et dansk CVR-nummer og dermed er registreret i Danmark. Desuden kan alle med dansk CPR-nummer søge.

geography.quote: Vi arbejder for mere og bedre natur i Danmark

access.quote: Alle ansøgninger skal indsendes via vores digitale ansøgningssystem GrantOne.
